input.address_owner: Canonical Base58 encoding of exactly32 bytes;32..44characters, exact re-encode; no curve/ownership verification.
input.data_hex: ASCII lowercase[0-9a-f]*, even length0..1024characters; malformed=>INVALID_DATA_HEX; computed length0..512 bytes. Empty/wrong exact role length is NC rather than input error. Global decoded-string length check occurs earlier: a hex string longer than1024 is INVALID_SHAPE at $, while in-bound odd/nonlowercase/nonhex/nonstrings are INVALID_DATA_HEX at the typedfield.
input.json: Strict UTF8/noBOM; duplicate keys including escaped equivalents, any numeric literal or nonfinite token=>INVALID_JSON. Check all decoded keys/strings for unpaired surrogates before depth/string bounds; INVALID_TEXT. Root container depth1, maximum4; then any decoded key/string>1024 characters=>INVALID_SHAPE $. A json.loads RecursionError is DEPTH_EXCEEDED, not INVALID_JSON. Numeric rejection covers integer,float and nonfinite callbacks; JSON booleans/null remain typed values. Escaped valid surrogatepairs decode to oneUnicode scalar and remain subject to fieldgrammar.
input.profile: Absent/null/UNCONFIGURED=>PROFILE_UNCONFIGURED; other nonstring=>INVALID_SHAPE profile; other string=>UNSUPPORTED_PROFILE; only explicit fixed local name selects profile.

structural_precedence.rule: Nonobject root=>INVALID_SHAPE $. Unknown root key=>INVALID_SHAPE $, even if schema absent/wrong. Allowed root names onlyschema/profile/accounts.
Missing schema, any nonstring schema, or unsupported string=>INVALID_SCHEMA schema. Do not echo actual value.

After valid schema, missing accounts=>INVALID_SHAPE $. Profile is optional, so missing/null/UNCONFIGURED then givesPROFILE_UNCONFIGURED profile. Profile nonstring=>INVALID_SHAPE profile, otherstring=>UNSUPPORTED_PROFILE profile.
Select onlyLOCAL_M3_ACCOUNTING_V1, then authenticate fixedprofile before inner accounts grammar. Dependencyfailure takes precedence over malformed accounts contents.

Accounts must be object with exactlyconfig/inventory/mint/custody; missing/unknown/type=>INVALID_SHAPE accounts, before any record. For eachrole in fixedorder, require object with exactaddress/owner/executable/data_hex; missing/unknown/type=>INVALID_SHAPE accounts.<role> before thatrecord fields. Then addresspubkey,ownerpubkey,executablebool,hex in thatorder. Finish allfields/roles before conformance orpartialfacts; firststructuralerror makes fullERROR.
